root_cause: A shell heredoc embedded in a YAML run block emitted PR-body lines at YAML column zero. GitHub rejected the workflow before any job could start, producing an immediate failed workflow run with zero jobs.
prevention: Build the PR body with quoted printf arguments inside the YAML block scalar. Regression tests forbid the raw heredoc and any column-zero Obligation-ID line.

historical_replay: A workflow with PR-body metadata escaping the YAML run block must be rejected by regression coverage before merge.
The fixed optimizer workflow must use the quoted printf body builder and contain no column-zero Obligation-ID line.
